title: Bun run executor
description: Run a project with Bun: either the TypeScript/JavaScript source directly (`main`) or the compiled output of a build target (`buildTarget`).

main.description: Run this source entry file directly with `bun run` (no build step). Relative to the workspace root (or cwd).

buildTarget.description: Run the compiled output of this `@onward-partners/nx-bun:build` target (`project:target[:configuration]`). Add the target to `dependsOn` so it is built first.

runtime.description: Runtime for compiled JS output. Executables built with `compile` are started directly.

outputFile.description: Override the compiled file to start when it cannot be derived from the build target.

outputPath.description: Directory a `main` script writes to. Not used at run time: it only lets `outputs: ["{options.outputPath}"]` (set by the init generator in `targetDefaults`) cache the script's output.

cwd.description: Working directory. Defaults to the workspace root.

watch.description: Restart the process when imported files change (`bun --watch`).

hot.description: Hot reload without restarting (`bun --hot`). Takes precedence over `watch`.

bunArgs.description: Additional flags passed to bun before `run`.
